errors.invalid: This file is not a Gathir backup, or it is damaged. Choose the .zip file Gathir made.
errors.newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of Gathir. Update the app, then restore again.
errors.failed: Restore did not finish. Your shop data and photos were not changed. Try again.
errors.createFailed: Could not make the backup. Check that the phone has free space, then try again.
errors.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this phone.
errors.photoSaveFailed: Could not save this photo. Try another one.
errors.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to take photos.
errors.pickFailed: Could not open photos. Try again.

screen.title: Backup and restore
screen.subtitle: Your shop lives only on this phone. A backup keeps it safe if the phone is lost or broken.

status.neverBody: If this phone is lost, your designs, sales and customers are lost too. Make a backup now.
status.stale: Make a new backup once a week.
status.fresh: You are safe. Make another after a busy week.

create.where: Then save it to Google Drive, send it to yourself or the owner on WhatsApp, or copy it to a USB stick.
create.made: Backup made ({{size}}). Keep it somewhere other than this phone.

contains.title: What goes in a backup
contains.body: All designs with photos, piece counts and history, sales, customers and reports. Your PIN is not included.
contains.privacy: It has your customers' names and phone numbers. Keep it only in your own Drive or chat.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.body: For a new or reset phone: bring back a Gathir backup .zip file.
restore.sheetTitle: This replaces everything on this phone
restore.sheetBody: All designs, photos, sales and customers on this phone will be swapped for the ones in the backup. What is on this phone now cannot be brought back.
restore.sheetTip: Not sure? Make a backup of this phone first.
restore.restoringBody: This can take a minute for many photos.

result.okBody: Restored {{designs}} designs, {{sales}} sales, {{customers}} customers and {{photos}} photos.
result.okPin: Your PIN on this phone was kept.
result.invalidTitle: That is not a Gathir backup
result.newerTitle: This backup needs a newer Gathir
result.safe: Nothing on this phone was changed.

reminder.title: Time for a Gathir backup
reminder.body: A week since your last backup. Two taps keep your shop safe.
